name: Uncounterable Fast Castle
author: Red_ (Phosphoru adaptation)
source: https://aoecompanion.com/b/kxnt2j50mm — transcribed for Loom. Timings modelled on 25-second villager production, 130s Feudal and 160s Castle research; the guide itself gives no times.

notes: Build 2 Houses | First 6 Villagers to Sheep | Queue Villagers non-stop
Villagers 8-11 to Wood | Villager 8 builds Lumber Camp
Villager 9 builds 2 Houses, palisades gaps to the TC (max 5 tiles), then Wood
Villagers 12-16 to food under the TC (Boar, Deer or Sheep)
Villager 17 builds Mill on Berries | Villager 18 to Berries
Move 4 from under the TC to Berries | Keep at least 6 on dead Boar, 3 on dead Deer
Villagers 19-22 to Stone | Villager 19 builds Mining Camp on the safest Stone
Move 2 from under the TC to Stone (delay if it causes decay)
Research Loom | Click Feudal Age at 22 pop
In Feudal: build Market with 2 Villagers, Blacksmith with 1
Sell 100 Stone and 100 Wood, click Castle Age
Against an enemy Fast Castle: sell 300 Stone, buy 100 Food instead
If pressured, stop Villager production until safe
In Castle Age: build a Castle with the Stone miners | Train your Unique Unit
Resume Villager production and add economy behind it
